integrity: Complete proof and a self-contained exact-arithmetic finite checker are supplied. Finite checks are supporting evidence, not certification of the infinite theorem. Independent audit has not been performed.
limitations: The result is specific to sums of squares of cobalancing numbers; it does not determine all other squared related sequences or higher powers. The matching-literature search is not a proof of global novelty.
title: Exact GCDs of consecutive squared cobalancing numbers
